include _sn_party_to_summary.txt
snap A1_s0_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A1_s1_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A1_s2_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A1_s3_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A1_s4_info
sumkey DOWN

include ../../scripts/r2_summary_info_page_variants/_sum_close.txt
